name: Crabs
summary:
Key Features
Care for Your Crab – It’s simple. Get a crab, bring it home, and keep its food and water topped up for a few days. Take it out for a backyard adventure. When you are done spending time with your crab you can ALT-F4. The Crab will survive will the game is off as long as it has food and water. Make sure to check in before it runs out and refill as needed. Keep your crab alive as long as possible. Train it to improve its skills and discover new abilities along the way.

Real-Time Gameplay – The game continues even when you are not playing, so there is no need to keep it open between visits.

Backyard Adventure – Take control of your crab and explore the backyard. Discover secrets, face threats, and solve puzzles to discover new traits and abilities for your crabs!

Tank Variety and Customization – Unlock larger tank designs and customize them with decorations to create the perfect environment for your crab. (Coming soon)

Perfect for anyone looking for a low-pressure gameplay experience, Crabs captures the simple joy of caring for a hermit crab. Whether you are a longtime hermit crab enthusiast or just curious about these fascinating creatures, this game invites you to slow down and enjoy life’s tiny wonders.

Crabs is in early access and does not represent the final product. I will do my best at regular updates to improve the experience and add new features. Some content is still a work in progress. Please visit the Discord to report any bugs and share your feedback.
